chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Open your eyes during wudu (ablution), so that they may not see the fire of Hell."

key_terms.رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, the speaker of this hadith
key_terms.عُيُونَكُمْ: your eyes, referring to keeping them open during wudu
key_terms.نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ: the fire of Hell, mentioned as the punishment to be averted
key_terms.ٱلْوُضُوءِ: wudu (ablution), the ritual purification before acts of worship

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله say about opening the eyes during wudu (ablution)?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs believers to open their eyes during wudu (ablution). It connects an act of ritual purification with protection from the punishment of Hellfire, emphasizing both the outward practice and its spiritual consequence.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
(sw) said:
"'Open your eyes during ablution, so that they may not see the fire of Hell.'".
